title: Outside requests: a failure shows on the card and in Pulse; the form says what it's for
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "nothing in pulse and the add request does not make any sense." After #87 the Name.com card still said Nothing waiting, so the requests couldn't be read or saved, and the code swallowed why. Now it can't be silent: the card shows what the database said (Can't keep requests: …) and Pulse opens an Alert, 'Requests to outside companies can't be saved', with the same words and a link to the card. The bare + became a labelled button, Note a request we sent <company>, its fields styled like the card's other forms, its button Keep it in Pulse, and the empty state says what it's for: sent them a question or a ticket and waiting for an answer, Pulse keeps it as a case, reminds you after 5 days, and closes it when you record their answer.
